_note: Test cases for two search improvements in GRAi Imaging Guide, written against data/search/scenario_names.json (ACR Appropriateness Criteria). Not clinician reviewed. Reference grader: cases.test.mjs beside this file. guard_pass: a suggestion the guard must let through. q = the search; ids = scenario ids, the case passes when guardSuggestions(q, [scenario], scenarios) keeps AT LEAST ONE of them (several ids are given when ACR splits the answer into equally fair branches); kind = synonym | quadrant | extremity | lay | pregnancy | pediatric; why = one line; names = the scenario names for reading; today = pass | blocked with the code as it stood when this file was built. guard_block: a suggestion the guard must remove. q, id (one scenario), kind = region | side | population | opposite | negated, why, name, topic, today = blocked | PASSES (wrong). Any guard_block pair that survives the guard is a hard failure. inference: q = the search; kind = infer | negated | unchanged. offer = topics, the case needs AT LEAST ONE of them offered anywhere in the result of resolveQuery (empty = nothing required). must_not_offer = topics that may not be offered anywhere (hard failure when kind is negated). forbidden = regex no shown scenario name may match and, unless forbidden_topics is present, no offered topic title may match (empty string = nothing forbidden); forbidden_topics = optional regex for topic titles only (empty string = titles not checked). kind infer: the inferred topic must be OFFERED, not asserted; it counts as asserted when result.mode is "guide" with that topic, or result.mode is "list" whose first scenario belongs to it and the result carries no label (a truthy field named inferred, inference, question, suggestion, suggested, offer or label, or a notice). Asserted cases fail the case and are counted, with a ceiling at the baseline count (baseline.asserted). kind negated: the inference must not fire. kind unchanged: no inference is justified, the result signature (mode, sorted offered topics, shown scenario ids) must equal today. today = that signature when this file was built. Offered topics = every string in the result equal to an ACR topic title, plus the topic of every scenario object in it (keys understood, unknown, corrected, query and reason are not read). Shown scenarios = every scenario object in the result. A guide shows a whole topic and asserts no single scenario, so forbidden reaches it through the topic title only.
